deep_dive.title: How Do Professional Editors Evaluate the Editing Quality of AI-Generated Cinematic Video Ads?
deep_dive.abstract: On social media, we often encounter short-form video ads that employ cinematic editing techniques to evoke an emotional response. While AI tools are beginning to generate such cinematic ads automatically, we lack a fine-grained framework for evaluating these ads. In this paper, we first characterize social media video ad formats and identify cinematic ads as a recurring format in our corpus. We then analyze the duration, shot structure, audio and text elements, and editing techniques of cinematic ads to inform a two-stage generation pipeline in which an LLM first generates a shot plan and a video generation model renders the video. Using this pipeline, we generated 70 cinematic ads for 35 real brands and recruited professional video editors to critique their editing choices. From their critiques, we derive six dimensions of editing quality: narrative progression, audiovisual coordination and sound design, visual composition and graphics, shot-to-shot continuity, message and brand coherence, and temporal rhythm and pacing. We discuss how these dimensions can guide editing-aware generation, human evaluation, and automated evaluation of AI-generated cinematic ads.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: The paper proposes a two-stage pipeline for generating cinematic video ads and recruits professional editors to evaluate editing quality, providing a fine-grained evaluation framework.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 当前AI工具虽能自动生成电影式广告视频，但缺乏细粒度的质量评估框架。本文先刻画社交媒体视频广告格式并识别电影式广告，分析时长、镜头结构、音视频和剪辑技术，据此提出由LLM生成镜头计划、再由视频生成模型渲染的两阶段流水线。利用该流水线为35个真实品牌生成70条广告，并招募专业剪辑师进行多维度质量评估。此工作为AI生成视频广告的剪辑质量提供了可复用的评估框架和标注数据集。
